name: Pixelate resolve
looks: A portrait or scene starts as a coarse block of large, blurred pixels, then sharpens in discrete steps rather than a smooth blur-out, while supporting UI populates around it before the image itself is legible.
build: Render the source at very low resolution, then step the resolution up 2-4 times at discrete intervals with image-rendering: pixelated so each step stays blocky; time surrounding UI to arrive during the coarsest steps.
sound: A soft digital static or modem-like texture that clears as the image sharpens.
prompt: Show a portrait or scene starting as a coarse, blurred block of pixels, then sharpening in a few discrete steps rather than a smooth fade, like a connection warming up. Let supporting labels or messages populate around it while it is still coarse, so the beat feels live before the image itself resolves.
